## Infosys Product and Feature Updates

Infosys offerings center on consulting, digital transformation, cloud modernization, AI services, managed services, and industry-specific solutions.

## New Product Launches
- Infosys Topaz: AI-first services and solutions portfolio
- Expanded Cobalt cloud offerings for enterprise modernization
- Industry cloud and data solutions for financial services, retail, and manufacturing

## Major Feature Updates
- Stronger generative AI delivery playbooks and responsible AI governance
- Expanded automation across application operations and managed services
- More packaged modernization accelerators for cloud migration

## Platform Enhancements
Infosys continues to invest in reusable accelerators, partner ecosystems, and automation-led delivery efficiency.

## Product Deprecations
- Legacy labor-only models are increasingly replaced by managed, automated, and outcome-led delivery

## Regulatory Updates
Contracts should include data protection, offshore access rules, audit requirements, and industry-specific compliance obligations.
